subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit policy announcement remain open now that the 20-PR cap is documented and enforced in code?
rationale: The source and release behavior are already implemented, but the issue was reopened and pinned after that work, so the remaining choice is the lifecycle of a public maintainer policy notice.

options.title: Keep pinned notice open
options.body: Preserve the current issue as the public pinned policy notice until maintainers intentionally replace or retire it.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: Close the issue and rely on CONTRIBUTING.md plus automation as the public source of truth.

options.title: Replace announcement surface
options.body: Move the notice to a preferred docs/discussion surface, depin this issue, and then close it with the replacement link.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Preserve the current issue as the public pinned policy notice until maintainers intentionally replace or retire it.
